evidence: At 360x780 the content column stays 960px wide (x=0 to 960) and the page scrollWidth is 960, while body overflow-x is hidden. The screen shows only the left 360px, so every article line, component demo and code sample is cut at the right edge with no horizontal scrollbar to reach the rest.
fix: Add a phone breakpoint that sets .s-content to width:100% and replaces the 80px side padding with fluid padding; remove the fixed 960px width and the body overflow-x:hidden mask at narrow widths.

evidence: The sidebar container is only 60px tall at 360px wide, but its navigation starts at y=130 and is 172px tall. The links paint directly over the article: in the top capture the words COMPONENTS and ELEMENTS are superimposed on the Accordions description and its element links, making both texts unreadable.
fix: Collapse the sidebar into a real mobile header: hide .s-nav behind a menu toggle, or give .s-sidebar height:auto and place .s-content after the full navigation instead of at y=60.

evidence: All six statistic tiles are 102px wide but need 114-133px of content, and each has overflow:hidden. The rendered labels read Total Collect..., Total Conne..., and every delta reads From last ...; the sixth tile sits at x=258-360 and its 123px delta span is clipped at the screen edge.
fix: Use a two-column phone layout for the six tiles, remove the fixed .right width, and let the label and delta lines wrap with white-space:normal instead of hiding overflow.

evidence: The panel title is 213px wide inside a 191px heading with white-space:nowrap and overflow:hidden, so the phone capture renders Top Campaign Perfor... instead of the full Top Campaign Performance even though the panel can grow vertically.
fix: Allow this heading to wrap at phone width (white-space:normal; overflow:visible) or reduce its font size so the full title fits beside the panel controls.

evidence: The A-Z filter is one row on the laptop, but at 360px it wraps into A B C D E ... W on row one and X Y Z alone on row two. The ellipsis separator sits between E and W at the end of the first row, so the alphabet index loses its single-row structure.
fix: Keep the filter on one line at phone width with overflow-x:auto and nowrap, or reduce the item size and gaps so all ten entries fit; keep the ellipsis inline between E and W.
